```tikzcd
D^{q-1}(U,V) \arrow[r,"s_D"] \arrow[d,"I_{U,V}"'] & D^{q-1}(W) \arrow[r,"\Delta_D"] \arrow[d,"I_W"] & D^q(M) \arrow[r,"r_D"] \arrow[d,"I_M"] & D^q(U,V) \arrow[r,"s_D"] \arrow[d,"I_{U,V}"] & D^q(W) \arrow[d,"I_W"] \\

```
